section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study of body image and mental health conducted in the Portuguese population, with participants recruited from a private company, a retail service, and a higher education institution. Self-report questionnaires were administered in person after written informed consent, and data were cleaned to exclude participants older than 35 years and questionnaires with > 15% missing responses. The section does not report sample size, demographic percentages, measures (e.g., BAS or BMI assessment), or correlation results.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: "This study is part of a wider research about body image and mental health in the Portuguese population."; "participants were recruited from distinct institutions, namely one private company, one retail service, and one higher education institutions."; "self-report questionnaires were administered in the presence of one of the researchers..."; "data was then cleaned to exclude participants older than 35 years old. Also, the cases in which > 15% of the responses were missing from a questionnaire were excluded from the final sample."
